materiality_verdict.detail: The omitted performance register did not change manager coverage, fixtures, themes, widths, provider policy, or the deterministic test surface — those held up under re-inspection with evidence. It did expose four genuine shortcomings the build would not otherwise have caught: fabricated index-rebuild percentages (a direct violation of the register's progress-truth rules), whole-stack re-rendering in c3 on every data event, startup-scan language in one setting description, and the absence of progress-kind/source/wait-reason semantics on operation events. All four are corrected and test-proven. The mispathed provider adjudication was immaterial: its content was byte-identical to the copy the build read in full (sha-proven).
